articles.summary: WD-40 Company (NASDAQ: WDFC) today announced that it has completed the divestiture of the X-14 ® and Carpet Fresh ® brands to Malco Products, Inc. “The decision to divest these brands reflects our continued focus on allocating our time, talent and resources to the opportunities we believe will drive the greatest long-term growth and value creation, particularly across our maintenance products,” said Steve Brass, WD-40 Company’s president and chief executive officer. WD-40 Company will work closely with Malco Products, Inc. to help facilitate a seamless transition. D.A. Davidson served as the Company's financial advisor in connection with the transaction. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed. About WD-40 Company WD-40 Company is a global marketing organization dedicated to creating positive lasting memories by developing and selling products that solve problems in workshops, factories, and homes around the world.
